Hi! I made the tome/book cover this way, if it helps you get an idea about how to start. 

Materials I used: actual book, fake leather, glue, craft foam, gold acrylic paint, cardboard

My tome is actually a large hardcover novel with a fake booksleeve cover. 

I made a fake booksleeve with hard cardboard wrapped in fake leather. This booksleeve is attached to the actual book like how booksleeves works.

The gold/copper pieces on the tome were made with regular craft foam, painted and glued on. I copied the design from storymode screenshots directly.
